name: Austin Habitat for Humanity Youth Volunteering
what_you_do: Teens help build homes and help the families who will live in them. Ages 16 and 17 can do new home building. Younger teens do jobs like painting flower boxes, building tables or tutoring the kids of these families.
who_can_apply: Teens under 16 are not allowed on active building sites. Younger teens do other projects. For 15 and under, there must be 1 adult for every 5 kids. Ages 16 and 17 may help build new homes. They may not use power tools or work above 6 feet. They must bring a parent or guardian over 21. Home Repair and Blitz Build need 18 or older.
duration: Family Build Days happen 3 to 4 times a year. Other timing is not stated.
deadline_text: No deadline. Check the volunteer calendar for dates.
how_to_apply: Look at the volunteer calendar (austinhabitat.volunteerhub.com) or the general sign-up page. The youth page does not give its own steps. Call Volunteer Services at 512-472-8788 ext. 106. Or write to volservices@austinhabitat.org.
notes: The age 12 start is for the project ideas listed for 12 and up. Confirm the right sign up path for your age with Volunteer Services.
